snippet.title: You Can See Everything (2026): Release Date, Cast & Story | In Cinemas 16 Oct
snippet.description:
You Can See Everything (2026) release date: 16 October, In Cinemas. Stars Elizabeth Holmes, Nathan Fielder, Billy Evans. Directed by Nathan Fielder & Lance Oppenheim.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

You Can See Everything, a new movie releasing next week! You Can See Everything is a fascinating new documentary, and it is in cinemas from 16 October. Here is everything you need to know! It follows Elizabeth Holmes, the founder of the blood testing company Theranos, who was convicted of fraud. Thirty four days before she goes to prison, she invites a film crew to document her every move! What starts as an intimate portrait becomes a three year journey that gets stranger and stranger! So you will see quiet home moments, long conversations, and the filmmakers trying to understand a person at the centre of a huge story! It is made by Nathan Fielder, the comedian behind Nathan For You and The Rehearsal! He co directs with Lance Oppenheim, who made the documentary Some Kind of Heaven! It is released by A24, and it runs for almost three hours, so it is a real deep dive! The Theranos story was already famous from books, podcasts and a hit series, and this film brings a very different angle! If you love true stories and documentaries that keep you guessing, this is a must see! You Can See Everything is in cinemas from 16 October.

📺 Where to watch: In Cinemas

snippet.title: Crawlers (2026): Release Date, Cast & Story | In Cinemas 16 Oct
snippet.description:
Crawlers (2026) release date: 16 October, In Cinemas. Stars Matilda Lutz, Gregg Sulkin, Melina Matthews. Directed by Ángel Gómez Hernández.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

Crawlers, a new movie releasing next week! Crawlers is a creepy creature feature in cinemas from 16 October. Here is everything you need to know! It is set in the Paradiso Palms apartment building, where the tenants face a deadly invasion of spiders. With the building under attack, the cunning building manager might just be their only hope! So you will see tight corridors, panic, jump scares, and a lot of things crawling where they should not! Matilda Lutz plays Serena, and she is the star of the horror hit Revenge! Gregg Sulkin, Melina Matthews and Paul S. Tracey are also in the cast! It is directed by Ángel Gómez Hernández, who made the thriller Don't Listen! It runs just eighty minutes, so it moves fast and never lets go! If you love a classic creature feature for a spooky night with friends, this one is perfect! Crawlers is in cinemas from 16 October.

snippet.title: Street Fighter (2026): Release Date, Cast & Story | In Cinemas 16 Oct
snippet.description:
Street Fighter (2026) release date: 16 October, In Cinemas. Stars Andrew Koji, Noah Centineo, Callina Liang. Directed by Kitao Sakurai.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

Street Fighter, a new movie releasing next week! Street Fighter is finally a big live action movie, and it is in cinemas from 16 October. Here is everything you need to know! It is set in 1993, and it starts when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits two estranged fighters, Ryu and Ken Masters, for the next World Warrior Tournament! But behind the tournament lies a deadly conspiracy, and the two old friends are forced to face each other and their pasts! So you will see brutal fights, neon arenas, fan favourite moves, and a battle royale full of colourful fighters! Andrew Koji plays Ryu, and you know him from Snake Eyes and Bullet Train! Noah Centineo plays Ken, and he is the star of To All the Boys I've Loved Before and Black Adam! Callina Liang is Chun-Li, and David Dastmalchian plays the villain M. Bison! There is also wrestling star Cody Rhodes as Guile, and Joe Anoa'i, known as Roman Reigns, as Akuma! And Indian action star Vidyut Jammwal plays Dhalsim, so fans back home have a lot to cheer about! It is directed by Kitao Sakurai, who also worked on the award winning series BEEF! It is based on the legendary Capcom game that began in 1987, and the second game in 1991 started the fighting game craze! If you grew up with arcade fighters, or you just love martial arts action, this is a big screen treat! Street Fighter is in cinemas from 16 October.

📺 Where to watch: In Cinemas
🎬 Cast: Andrew Koji, Noah Centineo, Callina Liang, Joe Anoa'i

snippet.title: Whalefall (2026): Release Date, Cast & Story | In Cinemas 16 Oct
snippet.description:
Whalefall (2026) release date: 16 October, In Cinemas. Stars Austin Abrams, Josh Brolin, Elisabeth Shue. Directed by Brian Duffield.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

Whalefall, a new movie releasing next week! Whalefall is a survival thriller in cinemas from 16 October, and it is one of the most unusual films of the year. Here is everything you need to know! Jay Gardiner goes diving off the coast of California to find his late father's remains. But he is swallowed by a massive sperm whale, and trapped inside its belly with just one hour of oxygen left! Along the way he realises the hard won lessons his father taught him might be the key to escape! So you will see deep sea diving, a race against the clock, flashbacks with his father, and a lot of nerve wracking tension! Austin Abrams plays Jay, and you know him from Euphoria! Josh Brolin plays his father, and he is Thanos in the Avengers films! Elisabeth Shue, Jane Levy and John Ortiz are also in the cast! It is directed by Brian Duffield, who wrote and directed the alien thriller No One Will Save You! It is based on a novel, and it comes from 20th Century Studios and Imagine Entertainment! Part monster movie, part father and son story, it will make you hold your breath! Whalefall is in cinemas from 16 October.

snippet.title: Crystal Lake (2026): Release Date, Cast & Story | Peacock 15 Oct
snippet.description:
Crystal Lake (2026) release date: 15 October, Peacock. Stars Linda Cardellini, William Catlett, Devin Kessler. Created by Brad Caleb Kane.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

Crystal Lake, a new show releasing next week! Crystal Lake is a brand new horror series on Peacock, and it starts on 15 October. Here is everything you need to know! It goes back to where Friday the 13th began, and it is all about Pam Voorhees, the mother of Jason. Pam has not been able to shake her grief, since her young, sickly son Jason drowned in the town lake almost a year ago! Then two strangers arrive at her door, digging into her past, and a chain of disturbing events begins! So you will see a small town with secrets, a summer camp, dark woods, the lake itself, and the slow build of a slasher legend! Linda Cardellini plays Pam Voorhees, and you know her from Freaks and Geeks and the Marvel films! William Catlett, Cameron Scoggins and a strong ensemble join her, with eight episodes in the first season! It is from A24, the studio behind some of the most talked about horror of the last decade! The show is created by Brad Caleb Kane, and it builds on a franchise that started way back in 1980! Even if you have never seen a Friday the 13th film, the focus on a grieving mother makes it feel fresh and emotional! If you love horror with a human heart, Crystal Lake is a perfect Halloween season watch! Crystal Lake streams on Peacock from 15 October.

snippet.title: VisionQuest (2026): Release Date, Cast & Story | Disney+ 14 Oct
snippet.description:
VisionQuest (2026) release date: 14 October, Disney+. Stars Paul Bettany, James Spader, Ruaridh Mollica. Created by Terry Matalas.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

VisionQuest, a new show releasing this week! VisionQuest is the new Marvel series on Disney Plus, and it arrives on 14 October. Here is everything you need to know! It follows Vision, the android hero from the Avengers, who is now on the run with a bounty on his head. He has to understand what he really is, and he has to resist the influence of Ultron to survive! So you will see chases, big sci-fi action, deep questions about identity and the strange bond between a father and his creation! Paul Bettany returns as Vision, the role he has played since Avengers: Age of Ultron! James Spader returns as Ultron, the villain from Avengers: Age of Ultron! T'Nia Miller plays Jocasta, and you may know her from The Haunting of Bly Manor! Todd Stashwick and Ruaridh Mollica round out the cast of eight episodes! The series is created by Terry Matalas, the mind behind Star Trek: Picard and 12 Monkeys! It is a follow up to WandaVision, the Marvel hit where Vision first got his own story! If you love Marvel and the story of Vision, this is a series you will not want to miss! VisionQuest arrives on Disney Plus on 14 October.

snippet.title: Reporting Live (2026) Hindi Movie: Release Date, Cast & Story | Netflix 9 Oct
snippet.description:
Reporting Live (2026) release date: 9 October, Netflix. Stars Parineeti Chopra, Deven Bhojani, Adil Hussain. Directed by Dhruv Tripathi.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

Reporting Live, a new movie releasing this week! It is an investigative thriller, it streams on Netflix from 9 October, and here is everything you need to know! Sandhya is an ambitious young field reporter, and her cameraman Vinod is the reluctant partner who goes along for the ride! After a fatal incident, the two start digging into an illegal sand mining racket, run by powerful and ruthless people! So you will see a ground level news chase, dangerous locations, and a web of crime and corruption that gets deeper and deeper! Parineeti Chopra plays Sandhya, and you know her from Ishaqzaade, Hasee Toh Phasee and Amar Singh Chamkila! Deven Bhojani plays the cameraman, Vinod! Adil Hussain is also in the film, and you may remember him from Life of Pi! The cast also has Amol Palekar, Shekhar Suman, Nassar and Saswata Chatterjee, so the supporting bench is very strong! It is directed by Dhruv Tripathi, and this is his first feature film as a director! It is written by Dhruv Tripathi and Mihir Jadhav, and it shines a light on the problem of illegal sand mining! If you enjoy tense, realistic thrillers about people chasing the truth, this one is made for you! Reporting Live streams on Netflix from 9 October!

Doctor X: Mafia in White, a new show releasing this week! Doctor X: Mafia in White is a gripping new Korean medical drama, and it starts on 9 October. Here is everything you need to know! It is set in a hospital ruled by ego and corruption, where every doctor is fighting for power. Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

Take Charge of My Heart, a new show releasing this week! Take Charge of My Heart is a brand new Korean romance on Netflix, and it is such a fun one. Here is everything you need to know! It is about a rich company heir who has an artificial heart, and a woman who is literally electric! When they touch, her power charges his heart, and when they are apart, it drains. So they make a deal that keeps his heart beating! And of course, their deal makes his heart beat in more ways than one! You will see sparks, quite literally, along with funny moments, sweet moments and the classic rich man and everyday woman love story! Kim Young-kwang plays the heir, Baek Ho-rang, and he is a fan favourite in Korean dramas! Chae Soo-bin plays Na Bo-bae, and you may remember her from the sci-fi romance I Am Not a Robot! Cha Woo-min and Jeong Jae-kwang, who was in It's Okay to Not Be Okay, round out a lovely cast! It is based on a web novel, which is where so many of the best Korean romances begin! There are twelve episodes, so it is the perfect length for a happy weekend binge! If you love Korean romance with a fantasy twist, this show will charge your heart! Take Charge of My Heart is on Netflix from 9 October.

snippet.description:
Other Mommy (2026) release date: 9 October, In Cinemas. Stars Jessica Chastain, Arabella Olivia Clark, Jay Duplass. Directed by Rob Savage.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

Other Mommy, a new movie releasing this week! Other Mommy is a new horror film in cinemas from 9 October, and it is here to give you chills. Here is everything you need to know! It is about a young girl named Bela, who forms a bond with a strange presence in her home. The twist is that this presence looks exactly like her own mother, and it pulls her deeper into a dark and terrifying world! So you will see a spooky house, creepy whispers, eerie moments and a scary game of who is real and who is not! Jessica Chastain plays both Ursula and the Other Mommy, and you know her from Interstellar and The Martian! Young Arabella Olivia Clark plays Bela, and she is the heart of the story! Jay Duplass, Dichen Lachman and Arian Moayed also star, so the grown ups are in good hands! It is directed by Rob Savage, who made the clever lockdown scare Host and the Stephen King film The Boogeyman! It comes from the horror powerhouses Blumhouse and Atomic Monster, the teams behind some of the biggest scares of recent years! The film is based on a novel, and it plays with a fear we all know, the idea that someone close to you is not who they seem! If you want a spooky night out with a great lead performance, Other Mommy is it! Other Mommy is in cinemas from 9 October.

snippet.description:
The Social Reckoning (2026) release date: 9 October, In Cinemas. Stars Mikey Madison, Jeremy Strong, Jeremy Allen White. Directed by Aaron Sorkin.

Here is the plot, the cast, the director and why it is worth watching, a spoiler-light guide in under 90 seconds.

The Social Reckoning, a new movie releasing this week! The Social Reckoning is in cinemas from 9 October, and it is a big one. Here is everything you need to know! It is the sequel to The Social Network, and it follows Frances Haugen, a young engineer at Facebook. She works with Wall Street Journal reporter Jeff Horwitz, and together they take a dangerous journey that blows the whistle on the company's most guarded secrets! It is a thriller built from real events, so you will see secret documents, late night meetings, boardrooms and a race to get the story out! Jeremy Strong plays Mark Zuckerberg, and he is the star of Succession and The Big Short! Mikey Madison plays Frances Haugen, and she just won an Oscar for Anora! Jeremy Allen White plays the reporter, and you know him from The Bear! Betty Gilpin and Wunmi Mosaku join the cast, so every scene is full of strong performances! It is written and directed by Aaron Sorkin, the genius behind The Social Network, A Few Good Men and The Trial of the Chicago 7! His fast, witty dialogue is famous, so expect long, sharp conversations that feel like a sport! It is based on the real reporting known as the Facebook Files, so a lot of what you see really happened! If you loved The Social Network, or you just want a smart thriller about the world we live in, this is the one to catch on the big screen! The Social Reckoning is in cinemas from 9 October.

Cupertino, a new show releasing this week! Cupertino is a brand new courtroom drama on CBS, and it starts on 8 October. Here is everything you need to know! It is set in Silicon Valley, and the story follows a scrappy lawyer who takes on one of the most powerful tech giants in the world. It is a classic David against Goliath fight, with a small legal team, a huge corporation and a lot of money on the line. So you will see tense courtroom battles, sharp arguments, startup chaos and a peek behind the shiny walls of big tech! Mike Colter leads the cast as Michael Price, and you may know him as Luke Cage! Rachel Keller plays Olivia Siffre, and she is the star of Fargo and Legion! Busy Philipps, Nik Dodani and Ella Stiller join them, so there is plenty of humour mixed into the drama! The show comes from Robert and Michelle King, the husband and wife team behind The Good Wife and Evil! Their trademark is smart, funny legal drama with a twist, and that is exactly what this series promises! It is also a perfect fit for right now, because everyone has an opinion about how much power tech companies really have! If you love courtroom stories with real world energy, Cupertino is an easy yes! Cupertino premieres on CBS on 8 October, and streams on Paramount Plus.
